﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: asto-core v1.13.0 -> v1.14.1

## Context

Project `docker-adapter` (by artipie) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.artipie:asto-core` from `v1.13.0` to `v1.14.1` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/pull/536

## Your Task

The source code is in `/docker-adapter`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

  <artifactId>docker-adapter</artifactId>
  <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
  <parent>
    <groupId>com.artipie</groupId>
    <artifactId>ppom</artifactId>
    <version>v1.1.3</version>
  </parent>
  <name>docker-adapter</name>
  <url>https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter</url>
  <licenses>
    <license>
      <name>MIT License</name>
      <url>https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/blob/master/LICENSE.txt</url>

  <developers>
    <developer>
      <name>Kirill Che.</name>
      <email>g4s8.public@gmail.com</email>

  <scm>
    <connection>scm:git:git://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter.git</connection>
    <developerConnection>scm:git:ssh://github.com:artipie/docker-adapter.git</developerConnection>
    <url>https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/tree/master</url>
  </scm>
  <properties>
    <qulice.license>${project.basedir}/LICENSE.header</qulice.license>
  </properties>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>javax.json</groupId>
      <artifactId>javax.json-api</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.artipie</groupId>
      <artifactId>asto-core</artifactId>
      <version>v1.14.1</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.github.akarnokd</groupId>
      <artifactId>rxjava2-jdk8-interop</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.artipie</groupId>
      <artifactId>http</artifactId>
      <version>v1.1.4</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.artipie</groupId>
      <artifactId>http-client</artifactId>
      <version>0.3.9</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hamcrest</groupId>
      <artifactId>hamcrest</artifactId>
      <version>2.2</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.glassfish</groupId>
      <artifactId>javax.json</artifactId>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter-params</artifactId>
      <version>${junit-platform.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>log4j</groupId>
      <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.artipie</groupId>
      <artifactId>vertx-server</artifactId>
      <version>0.5</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>wtf.g4s8</groupId>
      <artifactId>matchers-json</artifactId>
      <version>1.4.0</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.cactoos</groupId>
      <artifactId>cactoos</artifactId>
      <version>0.50</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <build>
    <testResources>
      <testResource>
        <directory>${basedir}/src/test/resources</directory>
        <filtering>true</filtering>
      </testResource>
      <testResource>
        <directory>${basedir}/src/test/resources-binary</directory>
        <filtering>false</filtering>
      </testResource>
    </testResources>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId>
        <executions>
          <execution>
            <goals>
              <goal>integration-test</goal>
              <goal>verify</goal>
            </goals>
          </execution>
        </executions>
        <configuration>
          <failIfNoSpecifiedTests>false</failIfNoSpecifiedTests>
          <trimStackTrace>false</trimStackTrace>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>

steps.message:
All 415 tests pass (with 1 skipped). The fix is complete.

## Summary

The compilation failure after upgrading `com.artipie:asto-core` from `v1.13.0` to `v1.14.1` was caused by a transitive dependency conflict:

- `asto-core:v1.14.1` brings in `testng:testng` which depends on `junit:junit` which brings in `org.hamcrest:hamcrest-core:1.3`
- The project explicitly uses `org.hamcrest:hamcrest:2.2` for tests
- The older `hamcrest-core:1.3` has a different API for `StringContains` - it lacks the `StringContains(boolean ignoreCase, String substring)` constructor that the test code uses

**Fix applied:** Added an exclusion for `org.hamcrest:hamcrest-core` in the `asto-core` dependency in `pom.xml` (line 64-72), allowing the project's explicit `hamcrest:2.2` dependency to be used exclusively.
